picks.title: Nvidia, UW Institute for Protein Design unveil open-source protein design AI model
picks.excerpt: The UW Institute for Protein Design and Nvidia released RFD4-Proteina, an open generative model that merges RosettaFold Diffusion with Proteina-Complexa; Manchester researchers already used it to design active enzymes for a step in lenacapavir synthesis.
picks.rationale: Model-release slot: RFD4-Proteina is a new open-source generative protein design model (RFdiffusion plus Proteina-Complexa) that has already produced working enzymes for a chemical synthesis step. It is a different release from the 10-17 molecular-scissors study, and it is not pathogen-related.

picks.title: How to speak whale: AI uses eight to ten click sequences to predict sperm whales' feeding dives
picks.excerpt: Project CETI researchers fed sperm whale coda recordings into machine-learning models and found that a run of roughly eight to ten click sequences predicts when a whale is about to begin a deep foraging dive.
picks.rationale: Animal-communication slot: Project CETI finds that 8-10 codas predict a sperm whale's foraging dive, a concrete behavioral result. The 09-24 dog-communication card was a general overview, not this study.

picks.title: Computer scientists build tech tools to find experiments, detect citation 'hallucinations'
picks.excerpt: NYU's Dennis Shasha and students describe two web-hosted AI systems in the journal Information: Hallucination Nerd checks whether a paper's claims are supported by its citations, and Protocol Nerd helps scientists find suitable experimental protocols.
picks.rationale: Research-tools slot: NYU released two web tools that researchers can use now, one checking whether citations support a paper's claims and one finding experimental protocols. This is the most actionable item in the pool.

picks.title: Beyond tree cover: mapping the world's forest types
picks.excerpt: DeepMind's Forest Typology (ForTy) 2020 is a global 10-meter AI map that separates Earth's land into six forest and land-use types, plus an annual time series.
picks.rationale: Earth-observation slot: ForTy is a new global 10-meter dataset that separates natural forest from plantations, with an annual time series. It is a different product from the Earth AI geospatial cards and the 09-30 smallholder crop map.

picks.title: Google launches $150,000 AI competition to reduce quantum computing demands
picks.excerpt: Google Quantum AI launched a $150,000 Kaggle competition for AI methods that design smaller, more efficient quantum circuits for calculations.
picks.rationale: Quantum slot: Google Quantum AI has opened a $150K Kaggle challenge for AI-designed leaner quantum circuits. It is a separate announcement from Anthropic's Claude circuit work (10-18), and readers can enter it.
